note: Automated frame metrics for T0003 vs T0002, computed locally with ffmpeg+ffprobe+numpy on 2026-09-29. MSE on 0-255 scale, frames resized to 192x108. These are structural signals, not quality judgements.

keyframe_anchor_check_t0003.what: distance from each render's first/last frame to the source still it was given
keyframe_anchor_check_t0003.reading: Both endpoints land on their keyframes in every chunk. fl2va endpoint anchoring works as designed.

mid_frame_position_t0003.what: which keyframe each sampled frame (5/25/50/75/95%) is closer to, F=first L=last
mid_frame_position_t0003.reading: The transition completes in the first quarter to half, then holds the last keyframe. The middle of the clip is mostly the end state, not an interpolation.

frozen_frame_fraction.what: share of sampled consecutive frame pairs with MSE < 30 (i.e. no visible change)
frozen_frame_fraction.reading: fl2va is more static than ref2v in 4 of 5 chunks. c01 is the extreme case: the middle of the clip is the last keyframe.
